The congress was adjourned and did not reconvene before May 1990; in the meantime, the LCs Macedonia, Slovenia and Croatia had left the LCY.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The congress was never convened, and the committee itself―the last federal organ of the LCY―dissolved itself on 22 January _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The congress was never convened, and the committee itself―the last federal organ of the LCY―dissolved itself on 22 January 1991.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: According to _____ć, the statute adopted "was by and large a copy of the Statute of the Soviet Communist Party"
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: According to Ranković, the statute adopted "was by and large a copy of the Statute of the Soviet Communist Party".

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Like its _____ counterpart, the Yugoslav party centralised most decision-making at the expense of lower-level organs
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: According to Ranković, the statute adopted "was by and large a copy of the Statute of the Soviet Communist Party". Like its Soviet counterpart, the Yugoslav party centralised most decision-making at the expense of lower-level organs.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 6th Congress, held on 2–7 November _____, amended the statute
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The 6th Congress, held on 2–7 November 1952, amended the statute.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The statute of the 5th _____ had bestowed on the central committee the right to appoint and dismiss party organisers in special areas
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The 6th Congress, held on 2–7 November 1952, amended the statute. The statute of the 5th Congress had bestowed on the central committee the right to appoint and dismiss party organisers in special areas.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Moreover, the position of "_____ of the Central Committee", where the officeholder had "no right except an advisory vote", was abolished
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Moreover, the position of "Candidate of the Central Committee", where the officeholder had "no right except an advisory vote", was abolished.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 6th _____ also sought to democratise and make the party more transparent in its activities
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: If, by any chance, central committee vacancies were reduced to a third of those elected at the previous congress, an extraordinary congress was to be convened to elect members to fill the remaining spots. The 6th Congress also sought to democratise and make the party more transparent in its activities.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: These changes remained in force until the 8th LCY Congress, held on 7–13 December _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: These changes remained in force until the 8th LCY Congress, held on 7–13 December 1964.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 8th LCY _____ sought to clarify in the statute the accountability of the LCY Executive Committee to the central committee
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The 6th Congress also sought to democratise and make the party more transparent in its activities. For instance, the proceedings of the 3rd Extraordinary Session of the Central Committee of the 6th Congress, held on 16–17 January 1954, were publicly broadcast and made public in written form in Komunist, which was in contrast to the Soviet Central Committee which kept its activities mostly secret.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Critiques of _____ć claimed that he had created a machine within the LCY Central Committee that was neither accountable to the sessions of the central committee nor its executive committee
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Critiques of Ranković claimed that he had created a machine within the LCY Central Committee that was neither accountable to the sessions of the central committee nor its executive committee. Ranković defended himself, saying that he barred the other secretaries from discussing issues outside their scope of responsibilities.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The institutional framework established at the 8th Congress lasted until the 5th Session of the Central Committee of the 8th Congress on 4 October _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The institutional framework set up at the 8th Congress lasted until the 5th Session of the Central Committee of the 8th Congress on 4 October 1966. Earlier, at the 4th Session of the Central Committee of the 8th Congress on 1 July 1966, the LCY had purged Tito's presumed heir apparent Ranković, the Vice President of Yugoslavia and the head of the State Security Administration, for allegedly bugging Tito's bedroom.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Despite these changes, the executive committee still managed to relegate the central committee, as it did at the 9th Session of the LCY Central Committee on 16 July _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Despite these changes, the executive committee still managed to relegate the central committee, as it did at the 9th Session of the LCY Central Committee on 16 July 1968.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Rules regarding membership was clarified on 20 March _____ at the 6th Session of the Central Committee of the 10th Congress, which decided to institute a fixed formula of branch representation
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Rules regarding membership was clarified on 20 March 1978 at the 6th Session of the Central Committee of the 10th Congress, which decided to institute a fixed formula of branch representation.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: It established a new position, the _____ of the Presidency of the LCY Central Committee, in which the officeholder was limited to a one-year term in office
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: It set up a new position, the Chairman of the Presidency of the LCY Central Committee, in which the officeholder was limited to a one-year term in office.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The intention of these reforms were to strengthen the party and prepare for the post-_____ years
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The intention of these reforms were to strengthen the party and prepare for the post-Tito years. Tito died of natural causes on 4 May 1980.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Tito died of natural causes on 4 May _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Tito died of natural causes on 4 May 1980. The 11th Session of the 11th Central Committee convened on 12 June 1980 and on the suggestion of Bosnian Croat Branko Mikulić, decided that the LCY Presidency and Central Committee "should work in accordance with their duties and with the authorisation provided for in the Standing Rules of the Party Statutes concerning their work and on the basis of the decisions to be made at today’s [12 June 1980] plenum." The eleventh session decided not to elect ...

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Instead, a five-member _____ of the LCY Central Committee, which was to be elected at each convocation of a session of the LCY Central Committee, would function as the collective party presidency
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Instead, a five-member Working Presidium of the LCY Central Committee, which was to be elected at each convocation of a session of the LCY Central Committee, would function as the collective party presidency.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: At the end of the session, he criticised Andrej Marinc, an ex officio member and the president of the Presidency of the _____, of rejecting reforms because they were "unconstitutional"
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: At the end of the session, he criticised Andrej Marinc, an ex officio member and the president of the Presidency of the Slovenian Central Committee, of rejecting reforms because they were "unconstitutional".

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Marinc argued that the reforms _____ć outlined might strengthen the federal government and central party at the expense of the republics and autonomous provinces, and was, therefore, not wise
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: However, beginning with the 14th Session of the Central Committee of the 12th Congress, held on 16 October 1984, when Serb member Dragoslav Marković proposed a series of political reforms that would replace consensus with majority decision-making the infighting was brought into the open. Marinc argued that the reforms Marković outlined might strengthen the federal government and central party at the expense of the republics and autonomous provinces, and was, therefore, not wise.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The LCY _____ was required to implement the Central Committee's policies if these goals were to be reached
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The LCY Presidency was required to implement the Central Committee's policies if these goals were to be reached.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The Central Committee elected at the 13th _____ comprised 127 newcomers and 38 reelected individuals
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: At the 13th Congress, held on 25–28 June 1986, the LCY admitted that there existed a "crisis of unity" and that it "challenged the very foundations of the communist revolution." The party statute was amended to strengthen the powers of the LCY Central Committee and its presidency. The Central Committee elected at the 13th Congress comprised 127 newcomers and 38 reelected individuals.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: In a bid to solve this crisis, the 11th Session of the 13th Central Committee, held on 7–8 December _____, decided to convene the LCY Conference, which was heralded as an "emergency meeting" by the of
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: In a bid to solve this crisis, the 11th Session of the 13th Central Committee, held on 7–8 December 1987, decided to convene the LCY Conference, which was heralded as an "emergency meeting" by the official press.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The Serbian Branch demanded to convene an extraordinary congress if the 1st _____ failed to solve the acute problems facing the LCY
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: In a bid to solve this crisis, the 11th Session of the 13th Central Committee, held on 7–8 December 1987, decided to convene the LCY Conference, which was heralded as an "emergency meeting" by the official press. The Serbian Branch demanded to convene an extraordinary congress if the 1st Conference failed to solve the acute problems facing the LCY.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 13th Central Committee's 20th Session, held on 19 April _____, formally approved the holding of an extraordinary congress: only twenty-four central committee members voted against the proposal
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The 19th Provincial Conference of the Vojvodina branch, held on 19–21 January 1989, adopted a resolution which demanded a vote of confidence on Stipe Šuvar (which he survived), the president of the Presidency of the LCY Central Committee, and the convocation of an extraordinary congress. The 13th Central Committee's 20th Session, held on 19 April 1989, formally approved the holding of an extraordinary congress: only twenty-four central committee members voted against the proposal.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Of those voting against, twenty came from the _____ branch, three from the Croatian branch and one member from the Bosnian branch
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Of those voting against, twenty came from the Slovenian branch, three from the Croatian branch and one member from the Bosnian branch.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: However, this was greeted by the Slovenian branch, led by _____čan, as threatening the principle of national affirmation and autonomy
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: However, this was greeted by the Slovenian branch, led by Milan Kučan, as threatening the principle of national affirmation and autonomy.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: However, the 20th _____ stopped some of Milošević's plans
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: However, the 20th Session stopped some of Milošević's plans. The twentieth session opted instead to adopt ordinary congress procedures, which made the LCY Central Committee the chief congress organiser.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 14th _____ convened on 20 January and produced a raft of policies
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The twentieth session opted instead to adopt ordinary congress procedures, which made the LCY Central Committee the chief congress organiser. The Presidency of the Slovenian Central Committee reacted on 20 June by convening a session of its Central Committee do discuss whether to convene an extraordinary congress of its own if the Slovenian branch was outvoted at the upcoming LCY extraordinary congress.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: On 22 _____, it adopted abolishing the LCY's monopoly of political power and creating a pluralist society
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The 14th Congress convened on 20 January and produced a raft of policies. On 22 January, it adopted abolishing the LCY's monopoly of political power and creating a pluralist society.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Upon losing several votes, the _____ delegation left the congress on 22 January, which was followed by the leaving of the Croat delegation
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: How to define pluralism was, however, controversial and Macedonian Milan Pančevski, the president of the LCY Presidency, argued, "The LCY finds unacceptable the thesis according to which the essence and form of political pluralism are reduced to a classic multiparty system alone" and that pluralism had to "be based on socialist orientation and the federal structure." Ciril Ribičič, the president of the Presidency of the Slovene Central Committee, countered Pančevski's argument, "[this is] the...

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The Serbian delegation led by Milošević wanted to continue the congress, but it was decided on 23 _____ to adjourn the congress and resume it at a later date
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: On 22 January, it adopted abolishing the LCY's monopoly of political power and creating a pluralist society. Upon losing several votes, the Slovenian delegation left the congress on 22 January, which was followed by the leaving of the Croat delegation.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The _____n communist party changed its name to "League of Communists of Slovenia–Party of Democratic Renewal" and introduced liberal democracy in the Socialist Republic of Slovenia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Upon losing several votes, the Slovenian delegation left the congress on 22 January, which was followed by the leaving of the Croat delegation. Shortly after the congress, on 4 February, a conference of the League of Communists of Slovenia adopted a resolution which stated, "for the Slovene LC the 14th extraordinary congress of the LCY has ended, and the LCY, in the form which it had up to the congress, has ceased to exist" and that the Slovenian branch would hereafter act as "an independent ...

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The Croatian and _____ branches mirrored the Slovenian changes and added "Party of Democratic Change" to their names while arguing in favour of turning the LCY into a confederal party
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The Croatian and Macedonian branches mirrored the Slovenian changes and added "Party of Democratic Change" to their names while arguing in favour of turning the LCY into a confederal party.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: However, during the session, representatives from Bosnia-_____ staged a walkout
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Despite this, a majority of LCY Central Committee members attended the session, with the army, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, Serbia and Vojvodina branches sending representatives, and with some representatives of Croatia and Macedonia showing up despite the positioning of their branches. However, during the session, representatives from Bosnia-Herzegovina staged a walkout.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The 32nd _____ of the Central Committee of the 13th Congress, held on 23 May, formally called for reconvening the 14th Congress on 26 May
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: When the LCY Presidency tried to convene the LCY Central Committee on 30 March for its 31st Session, it failed to muster a quorum, which was defined as each branch sending a minimum number of representatives to the session. Despite this, a majority of LCY Central Committee members attended the session, with the army, Bosnia-Herzegovina, Kosovo, Montenegro, Serbia and Vojvodina branches sending representatives, and with some representatives of Croatia and Macedonia showing up despite the posit...

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: It also decided to elect the acting president of the LCY _____ć, from Montenegro, as congress coordinator
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: It also decided to elect the acting president of the LCY Presidency Miomir Grbović, from Montenegro, as congress coordinator.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: However, at the 12th _____ of the Serbian branch on 16–17 July, the Serbian leadership adopted a resolution that stated that the LCY "no longer exists" and stopped supporting the committee's work
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: However, at the 12th Extraordinary Congress of the Serbian branch on 16–17 July, the Serbian leadership adopted a resolution that stated that the LCY "no longer exists" and stopped supporting the committee's work.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: With all branches eventually opposing its work, the committee—the last federal organ of the LCY—dissolved itself on 22 January _____ and transferred all its funds and property to the League of Communi
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: With all branches eventually opposing its work, the committee—the last federal organ of the LCY—dissolved itself on 22 January 1991 and transferred all its funds and property to the League of Communists – Movement for Yugoslavia.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Individual central committee members were accountable for their work to both the LCY Central Committee and the LCY _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: However, at the 12th Extraordinary Congress of the Serbian branch on 16–17 July, the Serbian leadership adopted a resolution that stated that the LCY "no longer exists" and stopped supporting the committee's work. It was answerable to the party congress.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: While answerable to the congress, it was supervised by the Commission on _____ (CSQ) and the Supervisory Commission (SC)
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: While answerable to the congress, it was supervised by the Commission on Statutory Questions (CSQ) and the Supervisory Commission (SC).

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: As part of its mandate, the LCY Central Committee oversaw the work of the LCY as a whole and ensured that the guidelines and assignments adopted by the LCY _____ were complied with
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: As part of its mandate, the LCY Central Committee oversaw the work of the LCY as a whole and ensured that the guidelines and assignments adopted by the LCY Congress were complied with. As long as it adhered to the limits set by the LCY Congress, the LCY Central Committee had the right to develop a political platform as well as adopt political viewpoints on significant issues, such as the development of the political system and international relations, as defined by the long-term and ideologic...

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: It also had the right to elect, among its own membership, delegations to, and the Presidency of, the _____ of the Socialist Alliance of Working People of Yugoslavia (SAWPY)
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: It also had the right to elect, among its own membership, delegations to, and the Presidency of, the Federal Conference of the Socialist Alliance of Working People of Yugoslavia (SAWPY).

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The Commission on _____, the Supervisory Commission and the LCY Central Committee commissions also had the right to convene sessions of the LCY Central Committee
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: The Commission on Statury Questions, the Supervisory Commission and the LCY Central Committee commissions also had the right to convene sessions of the LCY Central Committee.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The LCY _____ president opened the sessions of the LCY Central Committee
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: It also had the right to elect, among its own membership, delegations to, and the Presidency of, the Federal Conference of the Socialist Alliance of Working People of Yugoslavia (SAWPY). The LCY Presidency president opened the sessions of the LCY Central Committee.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The presidents of the republican branches, the autonomous branches and the _____ of the LCY within the YPA were ex officio members of the LCY Central Committee
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Each LC republican branch had an equal number of representatives in the LCY Central Committee, each LC branch of an autonomous province had an equal number of representatives, and the Organisation of the LCY with the YPA also had a fixed number of representatives. The presidents of the republican branches, the autonomous branches and the Organisation of the LCY within the YPA were ex officio members of the LCY Central Committee.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: For example, the 21st Session of the LCY Central Committee decided to convene the 12th LCY Congress in June _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: For example, the 21st Session of the LCY Central Committee decided to convene the 12th LCY Congress in June 1982. Later, on 9 April 1982, at the 26th Session of the LCY Central Committee, it adopted the congress agenda and the exact date for the convocation (26–29 June).

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Later, on 9 April _____, at the 26th Session of the LCY Central Committee, it adopted the congress agenda and the exact date for the convocation (26–29 June)
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: For example, the 21st Session of the LCY Central Committee decided to convene the 12th LCY Congress in June 1982. Later, on 9 April 1982, at the 26th Session of the LCY Central Committee, it adopted the congress agenda and the exact date for the convocation (26–29 June).

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: The LCY Central Committee was also to empowered to reject suggestions to convene an extraordinary congress as they did in _____–88
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Three months after the 11th Congress, held on 20–23 June 1978, the presidency convened and adopted on 19 October 1978 the "Rules of Procedure on the Organisation and Working Method of the Presidency" to institute and protect collective leadership. It set up a new position, the Chairman of the Presidency of the LCY Central Committee, in which the officeholder was limited to a one-year term in office.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Rather than calling an extraordinary congress, the LCY opted to convene the 1st LCY Conference on 29–31 May _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Rather than calling an extraordinary congress, the LCY opted to convene the 1st LCY Conference on 29–31 May 1988.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: LCY Central Committee members were, by right of office, delegates to an LCY _____
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Later, at the 2nd Session of the Central Committee of the 11th Congress on 19 December 1978, the presidency adopted the "Rules of Procedure on the Organisation and Working Method of the Central Committee" to institute and protect collective leadership. The rules of procedure were adopted unanimously and stated that the LCY Central Committee was the highest decision-making body of the LCY between the two congresses.

Central Committee of the League of Commu.subject: Ayurveda & Traditional Medicine
Central Committee of the League of Commu.subSubject: Central Committee of the League of Communists of Yugoslavia
Central Committee of the League of Commu.question: Regarding the 1st LCY Conference of _____, calls for convening it came from local and republican organisations
Central Committee of the League of Commu.fact: Regarding the 1st LCY Conference of 1988, calls for convening it came from local and republican organisations. It was the 13th Session of the LCY Central Committee, which convened on 28 February 1988, that scheduled the conference to convene in May.
